observations.route: Lokar, Brundt seal, Lady Zay's ordered crew investigation, lens and five symbol removals; Oneiromancer, Baba Yaga waking-sleep potion, elemental altar staff infusion; ore/helm, Pauline's amulet, Meteora's cape, four Suqah hides sewn by Rimae, Selene's ring; the brazier and six independently finishable dream trials before fighting Me.
observations.rewards: Two quest points, 5,000 Magic XP, 5,000 Runecraft XP, 50 astral runes, Lunar spellbook, Astral altar; seal of passage and nine gear pieces acquired during quest.
observations.notes: The lunar staff is untradeable and uses the Lost City dramen staff; a player must retain a usable lantern with oil. Equipment is checked without deletion. Six dream puzzles are order-flexible; the final fight requires all six.

requirements.food: Three distinct kinds, 6+7+7 pieces; current catalog selects cabbage, potato and onion as one concrete option.

observations.route: Cyrisus cave feeding and equipment, Birds-Eye Jack, Oneiromancer's dream vial, goutweed and crushed astral rune, the ceremonial brazier, and four sequential nightmare bosses: The Inadequacy, The Everlasting, The Untouchable and The Illusive.
observations.rewards: Two quest points, 15,000 Hitpoints XP, 10,000 Magic XP, seven additional Lunar spells, a retained dreamy lamp granting 15,000 XP in Strength/Defence/Hitpoints/Ranged/Magic, and bank access from Birds-Eye Jack without the seal.
observations.notes: Existing Eadgar's Ruse spare-goutweed action is the legitimate untradeable supplier; the 50 astral runes from Lunar Diplomacy supply the potion. Dream Mentor combat has ordinary death penalties unlike Lunar Diplomacy's dream.

open_questions: Verify exact island arrival and return routes; existing Lady Zay decks and their heights may be translated or instanced in RuneLite coordinates. Local travel edges are approximations and not an exact shortest-path map.
Verify Rimae's hide-tanning fee, the precise thread quantity per four lunar items, and whether the robe crafting stage requires an alternative tool. The current model estimates 400 coins.
Verify the Dramen staff infusion interactions and each altar entrance path against the four existing altar waypoints. The model uses the single staff through each transformation.
Check that the Oneiromancer issues the kindling and returns the waking sleep potion at the modeled handovers; interruption recovery is omitted.
Verify full-lunar equipment access constraints, combat spell/rune budget for Me, the six mini-game puzzle failure rates, woodcutting logs and combat incidental XP (not pre-credited).
Check inventory occupancy during a full nine-item outfit inspection (11 or more free inventory spaces), as the current route engine does not have a temporary free-slots requirement.
Determine whether the Nightmare armour and weapon choices from Birds-Eye Jack are retained, purchased or supplied; current two untradeable bundles are a planning abstraction.
Validate food type flexibility and exact 6+7+7 requirements, the mandatory support interactions and Cyrisus cave-to-mine shortcut; the current path uses a cave connection abstraction.
Verify combat level formula against the current live game; integer multiples of 80 represent the standard quarter-base and 0.325 melee/0.4875 Magic/Ranged style terms without fractional truncation.

Confirm dreamy lamp retention, minimum level, recovery on destruction and eligible combat skills. The pinned helper contains an anomalous lamp symbol; the catalog keeps the choice separate from fixed quest XP.
Verify the real status of seal-of-passage access to NPCs/bank before and after Dream Mentor, the Astral altar unlock condition, and whether there are alternate routes or optional return visits.
The tradeable preparation bundles use approximate GE costs. Quest item recovery, optional Suqah drop variance, death supplies and true travel durations require live verification.

integration.scope: Both quests are represented as discrete route actions and reward steps; the exact route remains draft until independent game observations.
